transcript:
sam: Heads up — seeing a sharp spike in 5xx/timeouts from hosted inference starting ~2026-03-15 14:02 UTC. Multiple customer escalations. Opening triage thread.

maria: Confirmed. Gateway metrics show surge in 502/504s from frontend-gateway -> inference-backend between 14:02-14:15. Error rate peaked ~28%.

kevin: Noticed auth service rotated signing keys at 14:01 UTC (rolling update). K/V cache TTL invalidation happened right after. KMS latency spiked briefly.

maria: Gateway logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T14:03:12Z [gateway] upstream inference-backend 502 "connection reset by peer"
2026-03-15T14:04:01Z [gateway] request_id=abc123 retry=4 client=10.8.2.34 status=502
```

ellie-support: Repro from a support machine:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< {"error":"upstream reset"}
```

tanisha: Ops note — opsbot set circuit breaker on route /v1/generate to 20rps at 14:10 to stop blasting the backend. That reduced visible load on inference pods.

deploy-bot: deploy: rollback inference-model-canary to v3.4.0 (triggered by kevin) — started 2026-03-15T14:12Z, done 14:13Z

maria: Correlation analysis: client library ACD v2.7 had a telemetry spike. It increased retry count to 5 and removed jitter. Combined with auth rotation that caused temporary 401s, clients retried aggressively and overwhelmed backend.

kevin: Mitigations applied:
- (done) circuit-breaker on gateway
- (done) rollback canary model that had slightly higher resource footprint
- (done) disabled client-side auto-retry at edge (gateway policy)
- (in progress) patch client lib to reintroduce exponential backoff + jitter

ellie-support: I'll update affected customer tickets and post a status page blurb: "We experienced elevated 5xx errors due to retry storm following an auth key rotation; mitigation in progress."

kevin: Action items for postmortem (owners):
- Add an alert that correlates auth key rotations with 5xx spike (owner: kevin)
- Add gating that prevents mass client retry config rollouts without canary (owner: dev-plat)
- Update client SDKs to default to jittered exponential backoff (owner: sdk-team)
- Add a playbook for auth key rotations that forces token refresh rollouts and staggered client restarts (owner: security)
- Verify canary resource usage differential in CI (owner: eng-runtime)

sam: I'll own the postmortem write-up and timeline. Tentative timeline: collect logs/traces, customer impact summary, root cause, and follow-ups by EOD +3.

tanisha: Also schedule a runbook exercise: simulate auth key rotation during peak to validate circuit-breakers and throttles (owner: eng-sre).

ellie-support: Support status: 12 active tickets opened, 3 escalated. Notifying top-5 affected customers now.

maria: Current metrics: error rate back down to ~1.8% after circuit-breaker+rollback. Latency normalized. Monitoring will stay in high-sensitivity mode for 24h.

sam: Closing war room for now. Keeping thread open for postmortem updates. Last check at 2026-03-15T14:22Z — nominal. :thumbsup:
